plates.side_label: FEB 1961 & 2 FEB 1963 TILL, MCCULLOCH & BECKER: 1 CLONAL MARROW STEM CELL (~1 IN 10,000) → RED CELLS (2M/S), WHITE CELLS & PLATELETS
plates.quality_reason: Flow-first: a teach diagram, chart, counter or timeline is a £0 code graphic. No Flow mint.
plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked Till & McCulloch spleen-colony linear dose-response & clonal stem-cell chart from Till & McCulloch (February 1961, Radiation Research 14: 213–222) and Becker, McCulloch & Till (2 February 1963, Nature 197: 452–454) shows 1 bone-marrow hematopoietic stem cell (CFU-S, ~1 in 10,000 marrow cells) both self-renewing and differentiating into erythrocytes (2 million/sec), leukocytes, and megakaryocytes/platelets.

teach_overlay.label: FEB 1961 & 2 FEB 1963: 1 BONE-MARROW STEM CELL (~1 IN 10,000) SELF-RENEWS & BUILDS 2 MILLION RED BLOOD CELLS/SECOND
teach_overlay.detail: Inked Till & McCulloch spleen-colony linear dose-response & clonal stem-cell chart on period paper from Till & McCulloch (February 1961, Radiation Research 14: 213–222) and Becker, McCulloch & Till (2 February 1963, Nature 197: 452–454) showing 1 bone-marrow hematopoietic stem cell (CFU-S, ~1 in 10,000 marrow cells) both self-renewing and differentiating into erythrocytes (2 million/sec), leukocytes, and megakaryocytes/platelets
teach_overlay.scale: only about one cell in every ten thousand inside your bone marrow is a true blood stem cell — yet that tiny handful of master cells manufactures two million fresh red blood cells every single second of your life
